# Snapshot generated from CLI documentation — will be replaced by CI on first run
# Tool: cargo-generate
# Command: cargo install cargo-generate && cargo generate --help

cargo-generate: Generate a new Cargo project from a given template

Usage: cargo generate [OPTIONS] [git|path|favorite] [--] [template_values]...

Arguments:
  [template_values]...  List of template values in the form `key=value`

Options:
  -n, --name <NAME>                    Name of the project to generate
  -f, --force                          Enforce to create a new project in an existing directory
  -v, --verbose                        Enables verbose diagnostics
  -t, --template-values-file <FILE>    Path to a file with template values
  -s, --silent                         Don't prompt and use defaults
  -l, --list-favorites                 List defined favorite templates
      --vcs <VCS>                      Version control system to use [default: git] [possible values: none, git]
      --lib                            Generates a library template
      --bin                            Generates a binary template
      --ssh-identity <FILE>            Use specific ssh identity
  -d, --define <DEFINE>                Define a value for a template variable
      --init                           Generate the template directly into the current dir
      --destination <DESTINATION>      Generate the template into a target directory
      --allow-commands                 Allow the template to run commands
      --overwrite                      Skip the check for existing files
      --skip-submodules                Skip git submodules when cloning
      --other-branch <OTHER_BRANCH>    Use a different branch than the default
  -h, --help                           Print help
  -V, --version                        Print version
